exposure: Perceived opinion of close friend/relative on TOLAC
outcome: Likelihood of transferring hospitals to pursue TOLAC
Actual transfer of care for TOLAC
cohort: TOLAC-eligible pregnant women receiving prenatal care at four hospitals where TOLAC is available and one hospital where it is not.
finding: More than half of women with a prior cesarean birth would consider transferring care if TOLAC became unavailable at their hospital, and more than one-third of women at a hospital without TOLAC actually transferred their care to pursue it.
